name: Maximilian Weber
bio:
Maximilian's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent watching Formula 1 races with his father. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics and data analysis. After graduating, he joined a smaller racing team as a junior data analyst, quickly impressing with his ability to extract meaningful insights from complex telemetry. His knack for identifying strategic advantages led to his promotion to strategist. 

Maximilian believes in a data-driven approach combined with an understanding of the human element in racing. He excels at predicting competitor strategies and adapting to changing track conditions. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to communicate complex information clearly and concisely to the drivers and engineers. He's joining Blau Motorsport with the hope of bringing new perspectives and pushing the team to the next level.

What sets Maximilian apart is his ability to see the big picture while also paying close attention to detail. He's not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and always seeks innovative solutions to gain a competitive edge. He also enjoys mentoring junior engineers, fostering a collaborative environment within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Maximilian is a tall, lean man with a focused gaze and a confident posture.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten race notes.
Has a collection of miniature race cars on his desk, each representing a significant victory.
Prefers to analyze race data while listening to classical music.
